evals.prompt: Open the Djinn Canvas Builder HTML artifact and verify that the component palette displays all registered components (button, card, modal, alert, input, hero-section, data-table, dialog, footer, etc.) with their variant counts and default variant badges.
evals.expected_output: Canvas Builder opens and shows component palette with all registered components, each showing variant count and default variant badges
expectations: Component palette displays at least 15 components
Each component shows variant count badge
Default variant badges are shown for components with defaults

evals.prompt: Drag a button component from the palette to the canvas and verify it appears as a draggable component instance with variant controls in the inspector panel.
evals.expected_output: Button component instance appears on canvas, inspector shows variant controls for variant and size
expectations: Button component can be dragged to canvas
Generated code preview updates with djinn_button tag

evals.prompt: Change a component variant in the inspector (e.g., change button variant from default to destructive) and verify the generated code preview updates to reflect the change.
evals.expected_output: Generated code preview updates to show variant="destructive" when variant is changed
expectations: Variant dropdown changes the component's variant prop
Generated code preview reflects the new variant value

evals.prompt: Copy the generated Django template code and verify it contains valid {% load djinn_tags %} and {% djinn_* %} template tags with proper opening and closing syntax.
evals.expected_output: Generated code contains valid Django template tags that can be used in a Django project
expectations: Code contains {% djinn_button %} or similar tags
Tags have proper opening and closing syntax
Code is valid Django template syntax

evals.prompt: Remove a component from the canvas and verify it disappears from both the canvas and the generated code preview.
evals.expected_output: Component is removed from canvas and code preview updates accordingly
expectations: Component can be removed via delete button
Removed component no longer appears on canvas
Generated code no longer includes the removed component
